format:
<script>
    (function($scope) {
    // 1. Wait until the dashboard header toolbar is fully rendered in the DOM
    var checkHeader = setInterval(function() {
        var toolbar = document.querySelector('.md-toolbar-tools');
        
        if (toolbar) {
            clearInterval(checkHeader);
            
            // 2. Create a single centered container if it doesn't exist yet
            if (!document.getElementById('custom-header-center-clock')) {
                var centerContainer = document.createElement('div');
                centerContainer.id = 'custom-header-center-clock';
                
                // Centering styles
                centerContainer.style.position = 'absolute';
                centerContainer.style.left = '50%';
                centerContainer.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)';
                centerContainer.style.display = 'flex';
                centerContainer.style.alignItems = 'center';
                centerContainer.style.justifyContent = 'center';
                
                // Giant, bold, dark charcoal typography styling
                centerContainer.style.fontFamily = 'Arial, sans-serif';
                centerContainer.style.fontSize = '32px'; // Bumped up to 32px!
                centerContainer.style.fontWeight = '900'; // Ultra-thick weight
                centerContainer.style.letterSpacing = '-1px'; // Tightened tracking for massive fonts
                centerContainer.style.color = '#2c3e50'; // Sleek dark charcoal tone
                centerContainer.style.lineHeight = '1';
                
                toolbar.appendChild(centerContainer);
                
                // 3. Start the live-updating clock loop
                startHeaderClock();
            }
        }
    }, 100);

    function startHeaderClock() {
        function update() {
            var now = new Date();
            
            // Format Date (e.g., June 28, 2026)
            var dateStr = now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
            // Format Time (e.g., 18:07:58)
            var timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour12: false });
            
            var container = document.getElementById('custom-header-center-clock');
            if (container) {
                // Combine them beautifully into one massive centered line
                container.innerText = dateStr + "   |   " + timeStr;
            }
        }
        
        update();
        setInterval(update, 1000); // Ticks every single second automatically
    }
})(scope);
</script>
